"pass" : "fail"; ⏎ if (verdict === item.label) { ⏎ agree++; ⏎ if (verdict === "pass") { ⏎ truePositives++; ⏎ } ⏎ } else { ⏎ disagreements.push({ item, verdict }); ⏎ if (verdict === "pass") { ⏎ falsePositives++; ⏎ } else { ⏎ falseNegatives++; ⏎ } ⏎ } ⏎ } ⏎ const precision = truePositives + falsePositives > 0 ?
